scope: Source and measurement semantics; development-only; no model fitting, scoring or attacks.
missingness_policy: Unknown in every benchmark bucket: neither zero totals, positive totals nor a passing diagnostic establishes complete measurements.
hard_rule_decision: Do not adopt the packet-duration bound or a zero-total exemption. Preserve notebook 08 profile v1 unchanged.
fixture_window_note: Explicit harness setting, not an assertion about the benchmark extraction configuration.

followup.selection_basis: Native malicious development labels only; exclude all 32 pilot rows; no model predictions or attack outcomes.
followup.claim_scope: Feature-space robustness under the unchanged explicit constraint profile; not packet realizability or IDS accuracy.
followup.primary_comparison: Relationship/profile repair inside MOEVA versus relationship/profile repair after native CAA.
followup.analysis_unit: Original record: average paired success differences across seeds within each original; resample originals, not seeds, for any bootstrap interval.
evaluation_notes: Report each model separately and its initially detected denominator.
Retain all selected originals; count existing clean misses separately.
Match core attack budgets and initial states; record additional repair/selection queries and wall time separately.
Keep fixed native matrix geometry when checking final selections.
Report all three seeds, per-original outcomes, attack coverage and rollback/duplicate rates.
The inputs have already participated in development-level clean-control auditing; they are not an untouched test set.
No new rule, threshold, scaler fit or model selection based on these outcomes.
Record bootstrap intervals are exploratory; they do not account for unknown host/window correlations. Do not claim population or network-level independence.

limitations: The exact original Zeek version, connection-log CSV conversion, collection configuration and row-to-UID mapping are not recovered.
